rules: Facts come from vendor documentation (source + date). Anything not checked is 'unverified'. Absence from the catalogue does not mean an app has no AI features.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint)
features.notes: Vendor: prompts, responses and Microsoft Graph data aren't used to train foundation LLMs; admins choose whether Anthropic models power experiences and which agents are allowed.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (web grounded, enterprise data protection)
Copilot in Power Apps / Power Automate
Copilot in Power BI and Fabric
Gemini in Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Meet) and the Gemini app
features.default_on: yes: the Gemini app is a core service turned on by default
features.notes: Vendor: content not used for generative-model training outside your domain without permission.

features.name: Zoom AI Companion (summaries, meeting questions, smart recordings)
features.notes: Vendor: audio, video, chat, screen sharing and attachments are not used to train Zoom's or third-party models; admins can enable or disable AI features for the account or groups.

features.name: Cisco AI Assistant for Webex
features.admin_can_disable: yes: user access to AI Assistant and AI features is managed in Control Hub

features.name: Slack AI (summaries, search answers, recaps)
features.customer_data_training: no, unless the customer gives affirmative opt-in consent
features.model_providers: third-party LLMs hosted in Slack's cloud provider (e.g. AWS) infrastructure

features.name: Slack global ML models (search ranking, suggestions; not generative)
features.customer_data_training: yes, unless the customer opts out
features.notes: Vendor offers an opt-out to exclude customer data from training Slack global models.

features.name: Rovo and Atlassian AI features
features.default_on: yes for Rovo Search, Studio and Bookmarks (always on, part of the platform)
features.customer_data_training: customer metadata may be used to fine-tune open-source models run within Atlassian's infrastructure
features.admin_can_disable: partly: admins can activate or deactivate AI-powered Rovo features; Search, Studio and Bookmarks are always on

features.name: Box AI
features.customer_data_training: no, not without the customer's explicit approval

features.name: Canva Magic Studio
features.customer_data_training: controlled by privacy settings; data may be used to improve AI services

features.name: Agentforce / Einstein generative AI
features.notes: Vendor (Einstein Trust Layer): data isn't retained by third-party LLMs and isn't used for their training; OpenAI is the provider named on the page.

features.name: Now Assist
features.notes: Data-sharing for model improvement has an opt-out in Now Assist Admin > Settings > Data sharing (per a ServiceNow community answer, not yet confirmed in product docs).

features.name: Workday AI and agents
features.customer_data_training: yes for contributed data categories; some features require opting in, and Universal MSA customers can opt out by support request

features.name: Zendesk AI agents and copilot
features.customer_data_training: no for generative AI (pre-trained models; third parties don't train on inputs); proprietary classification models may be trained on customer data as the customer instructs

features.name: GitHub Copilot Business / Enterprise
features.notes: Vendor trust centre: Business/Enterprise data isn't used to train models; other model providers may be selectable and are not listed here until checked.

features.name: ChatGPT Business / Enterprise
features.admin_can_disable: admin feature and access controls available

features.name: ChatGPT Free / Plus (personal accounts)
